limits: This audit checks current saved bytes/JSON field equality; it does not judge legal merits, historical law, citation support, or statistical validity. No holdout or original judgment attachment read; no model/main/verification/network command or database write executed by auditor.

The 80-field check concerns 16 core Stage1-3/question/verdict outputs. Step8 reports and two writer outputs are separate evidence classes. Exact fields preserve qualifiers; summary substring checks do not establish semantic completeness.

All three early Step8 calls (001/11,001/12,002/11) contain nested activity with child/tool payload gaps and were not accepted as passing gate evidence. In particular 001/12 reported pass but lacks independently captured child verification/full-text results.
Four initial Stage1 calls are unadopted environmental failures; 001/11 has a recorded execution stop and no final message. Saved file integrity does not make incomplete execution complete.

Six early infrastructure probe stdout/stderr pairs lack complete invocation/prompt/event records. Later no-model sandbox probes have separate complete manifests; no claim that every historical CLI invocation was fully captured.

001/13 and 002/12 later capture raw verifier results and complete-text visibility; these facts alone do not establish substantive support. Case002 raw111 latest108published/3unparseable differs from canonical DB106 statuses102published/4draft.

Current controller/manifests/status reports were updated after roles ended. Only immutable prompt/input/source fields and raw actor outputs are compared; controller status updates are not treated as actor-output edits.
001 writer object-to-string citation extraction is a recorded transport serialization conversion, not a legal-model or native-CLI defect.
Case002 current prompt is not byte-identical to its first/prepared version: only its recorded execution_environment binding was added; frozen legal task/header and legal input bytes are unchanged.

The two direct official HTTP probes are outside only-engine scope and remain recorded deviations; URL literals in serialized files are not additional requests. MXC loopback and documented directory-write limitations remain in the attempt audits.
